texts.zh:
我们的市场和研发部门为我们所有的基础顾客推出了一项人工智能应用领域的全新发明。新合成存在的折中方案让我们可以利用虚拟世界的优势开发利于现实世界的产品。

我们现在可以为无生命的物体注入限制性人工智能，让它们获得生命。然后，这个新产品细分可以进一步针对整个星系的消费者、私营部门和其他感兴趣的团体进行调整。
texts.en:
Our marketing and research department have come up with a new innovation in artificial intelligence application for our entire customer base. The balanced approach to the new synthetic existence allows us to develop products taking advantage of the virtual world to benefit the physical.

We are now able to imbue inanimate objects with constrained AIs and effectively give them life. This new product segment can then be further targeted for consumers, private sector and other interested parties throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh:
我们对虚拟空间的承诺开启了一条基于记忆的全新产品线。我们分公司的技术人员能够不受表型限制，从各种自愿受试者身上提取记忆。

我们的谍报部门也可以仔细检查这些记忆，使我们在这方面获得比其他帝国更大的竞争优势。最后，这些记忆被整合到我们的合成思维创造过程中，以获得显著的性能提升。
texts.en:
Our commitment to the virtual space has unlocked an entirely new product line based on memories. Our branch office technicians are able to extract them from willing subjects no matter their phenotype.

These imprints are then carefully examined by our espionage department, allowing us to gain a competitive edge over other empires on that front. Finally, the memories are incorporated into our synthetic mind creation processes for significant performance gains.

texts.zh:
尽管进行了细致的成本/收益分析，但合成化过程中的物理或虚拟专业化都不是最重要的。然而，我们不能在这些机会的边缘停滞不前，必须为利益相关者指一条明路。

对物理世界的关注使我们能够向无生命的物体注入限制性人工智能，并将其作为简化版的新生命出售。而对虚拟领域的投资将使我们能够将记忆和思维模式进行商品化。
texts.en:
Despite meticulous cost/benefit analysis, neither the physical or virtual specialization in the synthesization process is coming on top. We cannot, however, stand still at the edge of such opportunities and have to introduce one clear path for our stakeholders.

A focus on the physical world grants us the ability to imbue inanimate objects with constrained AI to be sold as simplified version of new life. Investments in the virtual realm would allow us to commodify memories and thought patterns.

summary.text:
# 合成化社会 / Synthesized Society

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/machine_age_situation_events_2.txt:2833-2940

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “合成冲击”事件链的终点：机会事件结束后180+随机90天，隐藏事件 synth.1500 按政体权威分发：民主 1505、寡头 1510、独裁 1515、帝制 1520、企业 1525。
  End of the "Synth Shock" chain: 180 days (+ random 90) after the opportunity event hidden synth.1500 switches on has_authority: democratic 1505, oligarchic 1510, dictatorial 1515, imperial 1520, corporate 1525.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 「企业政体」的最终事件：国家选择实体化（synth_physical）或虚拟化（synth_virtual）的合成体取向并设置国家标志，虚拟化选项还会触发 cybernetics.5046；另有一个保留现状的选项。
  The final event for corporate governments: the country picks a physical (synth_physical) or virtual (synth_virtual) synthetic orientation and the matching country flag is set; the virtual option also fires cybernetics.5046; a third option keeps the status quo.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 故事终点；五个政体版本互斥（由 has_authority 决定）。
  The end of the chain; the five authority versions are exclusive (by has_authority).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 仅出现给企业权威的国家。
  Shown only to corporate (authority auth_corporate) countries.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 说明：这十个最终事件（cyber/synth 1505–1525）不在任何审阅者的分配列表中，作为连带内容一并审阅。
  Note: these ten final events (cyber/synth 1505-1525) are in no reviewer's assignment list and were reviewed as part of the same chains.
- 已核对：触发条件、选项效果；编译树与脚本一致。
  Checked: trigger conditions and option effects; the compiled tree matches the script.
